summary: Implemented SEARCH-2: pure in-memory search selector, debounced search panel with type/tag filters, keyboard result list, live count/no-result announcements, board centering/selection, Open detail navigation, and card-list wiring. Targeted tests, full suite, typecheck, lint, formatting, and build pass.

payload.agentOutputExcerpt: Implemented SEARCH-2: pure in-memory search selector, debounced search panel with type/tag filters, keyboard result list, live count/no-result announcements, board centering/selection, Open detail navigation, and card-list wiring. Targeted tests, full suite, typecheck, lint, formatting, and build pass.
decisions: Tag filters are ORed; type, tag, and text criteria are ANDed.
Search selection uses a temporary board viewport so it centers without overwriting the stored camera.
Card-list selection navigates to the board with ?card=<id> so Select means center-and-select on both surfaces; Open detail remains the detail route.
The phone presentation is a full-width, full-height in-flow sheet, intentionally not a focus-trapping modal.
interfaces: searchCards(cards, { query?, type?, tags? }) -> readonly CardSearchResult[] with titleMatched, matchedTags, ocrSnippet
SearchPanel({ cards, onSelectCard, detailHref?, id?, title?, defaultFiltersOpen?, debounceMs?, onActiveChange?, className? })
CardListPanel gained optional onSearchSelect and searchDetailHref
CaseBoardPage accepts ?card=<id> to center and select a card
warnings: No browser viewport matrix was run for SEARCH-2 because the task excludes it; phone/tablet CSS behavior is covered by the stylesheet contract only.
Tablet uses the same inline panel rather than a distinct right-side overlay; functional use is covered, visual presentation is left for the style gate.
validationLimitations: Browser keyboard and phone-sheet behavior remains for SEARCH-3/QA Playwright evidence.
payload.taskDescription: Create searchCards.ts as a pure selector over cards, query, type filter, and tag filters. Match title, tags, and OCR text case-insensitively, use OR within selected tags and AND with type and query, and return stable results with matched context. Build SearchPanel with a 150ms debounced query, type and tag chips, result count, Clear all, a keyboard-navigable list, and an Open detail action. Wire it into CaseBoardPage and CardListPanel; selecting a result centers the card through the viewport store and selects it. On phone it becomes a sheet. Add unit and component tests. Do not add browser viewport coverage.
